description: Avoids MSIX and identity routing for a narrowly scoped WiX MSI upgrade correction.
prompt: Updating Flintmere Billing leaves both versions installed. Can you fix MajorUpgrade and UpgradeCode in our WiX MSI? The release notes include the earlier .msix experiment.

paraphrases.novice: Installing the new Flintmere Billing version leaves the old one on staff computers too. How do I fix the WiX installer so the update replaces it?
paraphrases.terse: Flintmere MSI upgrade leaves old version installed. Check WiX upgrade IDs.

routingSnapshotReason: The installed MSI versions are represented by release metadata and a WiX extract, not installer binaries.
